object_description: two school buildings set at right angles on a base, with the sports hall under the playground
design_condition: the two buildings are arranged at right angles on a base that clearly delimits the schoolyard, with the sports hall buried under it and the second-stage building placed upstream of the stream

positive: Two buildings at right angles on a base clearly delimit the schoolyard
The hall under the playground allows an underground connection between the school buildings
The compactness of the volumes and the sloping roofs seek an adequate scale relationship with the village
They leave a maximum of free passages and breakthroughs on the landscape balcony overlooking the lake
Two entry levels are envisaged, the lower giving access from the car park to the public uses
The after-school programme benefits from its own outdoor space well separated from the schoolyard
The upper entry level is in contact with the courtyard and reachable by a wide staircase ramp
The general organisation is clear and functional
Classrooms are organised along large distribution corridors facing the courtyard
The jury appreciated the typological quality and the general compactness
The supporting system is simple and rational, with facade lines, median walls and service cores
Combined with the typological layout it allows great flexibility of use and organisation
negative: The excessive multiplicity of accesses does not allow a more obvious organisation
The multiplication of stairwells and the generosity of clearance surfaces contradict the desired economy
The largely buried sports halls require significant earthworks and their lighting is insufficient
The machine room layout does not work, with difficult access and undersized doors
The full-height glazed courtyard facades without solar protection can cause summer overheating
The apparent simplicity is contradicted by the differentiated treatment of entrances and facades
Two levels on the courtyard side and four on the opposite side contradict integration into the surroundings
